stages.mission1: Mission 1: the house in the woods

cards.Mission: The house in the woods — day 30, afternoon

lowHp: I've had worse. Not much worse.
outOfAmmo: That's the last round. Make it count.
herdBreach: They're through. Fall back to the stove.
idle: Six of us went out hunting. ...Forget it.
Rounds, exits, people. Always the same count.

lowHp: Okay, that hurt. That really hurt.
I'm fine. I'm fine. I'm not fine.
firstKill: That was real. That was really real.
openingFixed: Nailed it. Almost like I know what I'm doing.
trapKill: The trap got it! I love this trap.
herdBreach: That's too many. That's way too many.
idle: Mum would've hated this stove. She'd have fixed it anyway.
Two valleys. That's all it is. Two valleys.
I could run it in a day. If it were just me.

start.speaker: Cass
start.text: Sundown in two hours. Maybe less.

start.speaker: Cass
start.text: Two ways out. The creek and the road. I've checked both twice.

start.speaker: Cass
start.text: No food since yesterday. One knife. A pistol with nothing in it.

start.speaker: Cass
start.text: Eli said an hour. That was three ago.

start.speaker: Cass
start.text: I know how this goes when someone's late. I'm not doing that again.

start.speaker: Cass
start.text: Move. Check the fire. Smoke draws them.

afterMove.speaker: Cass
afterMove.text: Something at the edge of camp, dragging its feet. Knife. Quiet.

afterKnife.speaker: Cass
afterKnife.text: Close and quiet. The only way we can afford it now.

afterKnife.speaker: Eli
afterKnife.text: Cass! Don't move, I've got it!

afterGun.speaker: Eli
afterGun.text: Two rounds left. ...Hi. Sorry I'm late.

afterGun.speaker: Eli
afterGun.text: I went up the ridge. There's a house, Cass. North, through the trees.

afterGun.speaker: Eli
afterGun.text: I couldn't get close enough to say. ...I'm never sure.

afterGun.speaker: Cass
afterGun.text: Then we find out. First, something's moving in the trees. Plant yourself, face the woods, and let it walk right into you.

afterHold.speaker: Cass
afterHold.text: That's three down, and everything within a mile heard us.

afterHold.speaker: Cass
afterHold.text: A tent, a fire and nothing to eat. We're a dinner bell.

afterHold.speaker: Cass
afterHold.text: Stay low, stay close. And next time you're late, send word.

m01Start.speaker: Cass
m01Start.text: Rounds are for emergencies. Everything else, quiet.

m01Start.speaker: Eli
m01Start.text: And when there's a cluster we can't sneak around?

m01Start.speaker: Cass
m01Start.text: You draw them off. You run, they follow, I finish them from behind.

m01Start.speaker: Cass
m01Start.text: You're fast. Once per place, though. After that you're too winded to run and too proud to say so.

m01Start.speaker: Eli
m01Start.text: That's the nicest thing you've said to me.

m01Ambush.speaker: Eli
m01Ambush.text: Clear. All of it. I keep waiting for one more to come out of the walls.

m01Ambush.speaker: Eli
m01Ambush.text: Cass... that's not one more. That's six.

m01Ambush.speaker: Cass
m01Ambush.text: Back to the wall. We can't hold six.

m01Rescue.speaker: June
m01Rescue.text: Four for me, two for you, Tahca Wanyaka. You're getting slow.

m01Rescue.speaker: Ray
m01Rescue.text: You shot from too close again, Wakpa Win.

m01Rescue.speaker: Ray
m01Rescue.text: Easy. We're not here to take anything. I'm Ray. This is my daughter, June.

m01Rescue.speaker: Cass
m01Rescue.text: Cass. That's Eli. You were watching us.

m01Rescue.speaker: Ray
m01Rescue.text: Since morning. I wanted to know what kind of people you were.

m01Rescue.speaker: June
m01Rescue.text: He wanted to know. I wanted to come down hours ago.

m01Rescue.speaker: Eli
m01Rescue.text: Where did you even come from?

m01Rescue.speaker: Ray
m01Rescue.text: The woods. Thirty days of them. We were hunting deer when it started.

m01Rescue.speaker: Ray
m01Rescue.text: Clouds are building in the west. Rain tonight, a lot of it. Not a night to be outside.

m01Rescue.speaker: Cass
m01Rescue.text: The door's broken. The windows are gone.

m01Rescue.speaker: Ray
m01Rescue.text: Then we fix them together. Four hold a house better than two.

m01Rescue.speaker: June
m01Rescue.text: Deal. I call the room with the bed.

base1Arrival.speaker: Eli
base1Arrival.text: Wait. Is that a pistol? You've had a pistol in your pack this whole time?

base1Arrival.speaker: Cass
base1Arrival.text: Empty. Out there a shot meant company, so I kept it for a night I could afford to be loud.

base1Arrival.speaker: Cass
base1Arrival.text: Four walls, and a door we're about to fix. One pile of rounds, two guns. Don't waste mine either.

north.speaker: Cass
north.text: Stop. Everybody stop. Do you hear that?

north.speaker: Cass
north.text: Exactly. The birds went quiet. Something big is moving in the north, and it isn't one or two.

north.speaker: Cass
north.text: Two minutes. Maybe less. Seal whatever you can.

east.speaker: Cass
east.text: Stop. Everybody stop. Do you hear that?

east.speaker: Cass
east.text: Exactly. The crows just left the east ridge. Something big is moving that way, and it isn't one or two.

east.speaker: Cass
east.text: Two minutes. Maybe less. Seal whatever you can.

south.speaker: Cass
south.text: Stop. Everybody stop. Do you hear that?

south.speaker: Cass
south.text: Exactly. The birds went quiet along the trail. Something big is coming up from the south, and it isn't one or two.

south.speaker: Cass
south.text: Two minutes. Maybe less. Seal whatever you can.

west.speaker: Cass
west.text: Stop. Everybody stop. Do you hear that?

west.speaker: Cass
west.text: Exactly. Listen west, under the wind. Something big is moving there, and it isn't one or two.

west.speaker: Cass
west.text: Two minutes. Maybe less. Seal whatever you can.

base1Win.speaker: Eli
base1Win.text: I think so. I think we actually did it.

base1Win.speaker: Cass
base1Win.text: Sit down before you fall down.

base1Win.speaker: Eli
base1Win.text: We held. Against that. I never thought we would.

base1Win.speaker: Cass
base1Win.text: Neither did I. Eat, sleep. Tomorrow we find out how far we are from anything alive.

warning.speaker: Cass
warning.text: I'm not hungry. Eat yours first.

warning.speaker: Eli
warning.text: My legs are going. I need to eat something.
